paper: Tsioutis, Pourgourides, Timotheou — Cycle-Level Distribution-Based Calibration of Microscopic Intersection Models Using UAV Trajectories, SUMO UC 2026 (pre-print-3289)

run.optimizer: NGOpt (nevergrad 1.0.12), budget 700, num_workers 4, seed 42, x0 = bounds midpoint (authors' script)

nABC_eq12.note: volume-weighted behavior matches the paper (low-volume pairs improve less); absolute levels far above the paper's

objective_arithmetic_verified: weighted sum of per-pair deltas reproduces optimizer J to 0.01 — pipeline exact
deviations: authors' osm.net.xml NOT shipped -> reconstructed from OSM (split 23182965#0@13m, lane counts to detector layout, junctions.join to their single-junction topology)
InfoProcess.py NOT shipped -> reimplemented from the data contract
Data/TrafficLightCycles.csv NOT shipped -> in-code fallback windows (0-60/60-90) used
detector positions clamped to reconstructed lane lengths
condensed 2-edge routes expanded to connected paths (endpoints unchanged)
their history vector includes more parameters than the shipped script -> shipped script taken as the authoritative artifact
verdict: METHOD_REPRODUCED / RESULT_PARTIAL — calibration improves the dominant movement 53->26% nABC on the reconstruction, but the paper's 0.46% level requires their exact unshipped network and signal table. Our-site (d8) application: NOT YET RUN.
